items.evidence: leverage play work --ticks 0 printed {tick:0, screen:title, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts}: every key of the brief; tick equals ticks run on every screen.
--frame X.png --size 800x480 after runs on title, settings, shop and play wrote PNGs; header checked: PNG signature, 800 x 480.
Fresh place: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 3:enter -> tick 4 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate 10.

Settings: 11 lefts from 8 stop at 0, 13 rights stop at 10; language en->es->fr and stops at fr, back to en and stops; difficulty normal by default, right -> hard (stops), left -> normal -> easy (stops).

es and fr runs: title (Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir; Meilleur/Commencer/Reglages/Quitter), settings, play HUD, shop, paused (En pausa/Reanudar/Titulo; Pause/Reprendre/Titre), won (Has ganado; Vous avez gagne), lost (Has perdido; Vous avez perdu) all translated; only the game name stays English. Strings files have the same keys.
Run 1 in folder set2 set volume 6, es, hard; run 2 in set2 started at volume 6, es, hard (and gate 7). Run in a new folder started at volume 8, en, normal.
Holding up: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 per tick (6/s), reaches 12 and stays there; holding down reaches 0 and stays. Guard drawn at x=2 in the frame.
Held shoot from tick 4: new bolts at ticks 5, 29, 53, 77 (24 apart); bolt x grows 0.2333 per tick (14/s); a bolt at 19.97 is gone next tick.
Seed 1, wave 1: walkers appear at x=20 at ticks 4, 94, 184, 274, 364 (90 ticks = 1.5 s) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x falls 0.025 per tick (1.5/s); exactly 5 then shop.

Bolts in lane 2: walker health 2 -> 1 at ~tick 115 (bolt removed), destroyed ~tick 135 with score 0->10, coins 0->1; a lane-2 bolt passed the lane-4 walker's x (bolt at 19.97, walker at 18.1) leaving it at health 2.
No shooting: walker at x 0.025 at tick 803 is gone at 804, gate 10 -> 9, score and coins stay 0. Gate reaching 0: screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 50, Best: 50, Enter: title].
Start with difficulty easy (kept setting) -> gate_health 14; with hard -> gate_health 7.

Last wave-1 walker gone -> screen shop, enemies and bolts empty, guard_y unchanged while up is held, escape does nothing; texts show Coins: 5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands ... price 5, Heavy bolts ... price 12, Mason ... price 4, Next wave.
--set coins=100: Quick once (105->100) then held shoot fires at ticks 621, 639, 657 (18 apart); twice (100->90) fires 621, 633, 645 (12 apart); third Enter: coins stay 90, quick stays 2.
Heavy bought (12 coins): a fresh wave-2 walker (health 2) spawned at tick 857 is destroyed by one bolt by tick 859 (score +10); second Enter on Heavy: coins 78 unchanged, heavy stays 1.
Gate 5 of 10 with 9 coins: Mason -> gate 8 coins 5; Mason -> gate 10 (not 11) coins 1; Mason again -> unchanged. With 0 coins: unchanged. With gate full at 10 and 5 coins: unchanged.
Next wave entered play at tick 617, first wave-2 walker at 677 (60 ticks); 7 walkers spawned 90 ticks apart (677..1217), none after; HUD 'Wave 2 of 8' (Oleada 2 de 8 / Vague 2 sur 8).

Wave 3 (no shooting): 6 walkers then 4 runners spawned every 72 ticks (1437..2085); runner health 1, x falls 0.05/tick (3/s, spacing seen 2.4 at 48 ticks in wave 8); runner kills gave +15 score and +1 coin each.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute at tick 2943, health 6, crosses 20 units in 1200 ticks (1/s); reaching gate: gate 6 -> 3, no points; destroyed in the shooting run: score +40, coins +3.
modules/work/waves.csv holds one line per wave (walkers, runners, brutes, seconds), read by the rules; README 'Changing a wave' says to edit that file. Spawn counts/gaps seen match the file.
Easy, coins hook, sweep-and-shoot script: 8 waves cleared, tick 8048 screen won, score 1285 + last brute 40 = 1325 points + 20*14 gate = 1605 shown; Enter at tick 8064 -> title.

Escape pauses (enemy x frozen at 19.625 for 40 ticks) and Title returns to the title, but Enter on Resume (menu_index 0) does nothing: screen stayed paused through ticks 101-140 in three runs; only Escape resumed.
saved false during wave 1, true at the shop; next run in same folder: texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit] (from tick 1 on).
Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 50, coins 5, gate 10; bought Quick (coins 0); next run Continue -> shop quick 1, coins 0; Next wave -> play wave 2, first enemy 60 ticks later.
Title from pause -> title still shows Continue (saved true); Start -> saved false, later title has no Continue; lost run -> saved false and no Continue next run; won screen saved false.
Lost with 50 -> lost screen Best: 50, next run title Best: 50; later lost with 0 -> Best stays 50; won with 1605 -> won screen Best: 1,605 and title Best: 1,605 later.
Two copies of one kept folder, seed 7, 3000 ticks of the same script, 30 states each: files byte-identical (same md5). Seed 8 put wave-1 walkers in lanes 6,6,6,6,2 vs seed 7's 10,6,2,2,4.

Wave 8 frame: grey gate strip at left, blue guard at x 2 y 6.7, green walker squares, yellow runner spheres, large red brute at x 19.4 y 10, white bolts at y 6.7, all at the state's positions; HUD Score 945, Coins 1,046, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 10.
Frames: Spanish title with Ajustes outlined (menu_index 1); French settings with 'Difficulte : Difficile' outlined (index 2); English shop with Mason outlined (index 2).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json (same keys), screens use @keys; README 'Adding a language' says copy en.json, set locale/name, translate.
README has How to play, the headless-run and frame commands (both run as written and gave JSON / an 800x480 PNG), where kept values are kept (settings.json in --settings folder).

defects: The pause menu's Resume button does nothing (its action 'resume' never reaches the rules); only Escape leaves the pause.
A run of 0 ticks shows best 0 and saved false whatever is kept (kept values arrive at tick 1); README admits it.
On the settings screen, 'texts' also lists the title's strings under the overlay (title name, Best, Start, Settings, Quit).
